name: Gerald Meerschaert
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A 39-year-old submission specialist (37 wins) moving up to light heavyweight after five straight losses, two by stoppage. Still dangerous off his back and in scrambles; the athleticism has faded.

how_they_fight.Grappling: Opportunistic submissions (about 1.2 attempts per 15 minutes); weak takedown defense (about 49%).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped by Oleksiejczuk (KO) and Daukaus (sub) in 2025.

concerns: Age, five-fight skid, moving up in weight

news.text: Moves up to light heavyweight after five straight losses.

sources.title: 26-Fight UFC Veteran Set to Change Weight Classes After 5-Straight Losses
